subject: NimbleDocs onboarding: cost & performance implementation plan

Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding kickoff — cost/perf focus

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Tom and I wanted to confirm next steps for the implementation. Our top priorities are: reducing per-token cost while keeping 95th pct latency below 650ms, and having a safe fallback plan for peak events. We captured some initial traffic patterns and example requests in the attached CSV.

Can we include performance tuning (batching, KV/prefix caching, and a quantization recommendation) as part of the first rollout? Our infra team is sensitive to any accuracy drop from aggressive quantization.

Suggested availability next week for a 60m handoff: Tue/Thu mornings.

Appreciate the quick turn here — Sana

Hi Sana / Tom — great to have you moving forward. looping in Monica (CS lead) and Marissa (implementation) to scope the technical handoff.

High-level plan I propose for the first rollout (2–3 week initial cadence):

- Week 0 (Prep): share sample request payloads and p95/p99 traffic buckets (Monica).
- Week 1 (Tune): run a 2-day quant/latency sweep on a representative subset; test two quant profiles (q4-lite, q6-balanced). Evaluate token-level accuracy on a 200-case prompt set.
- Week 2 (Canary): enable batching and KV-prefix caching for 50% of traffic; route spike traffic to a higher-capacity fallback model variant.
- Week 3 (Full roll): promote successful configs, capture token cost delta and latency SLOs in Console dashboards.

Key asks from your side: sample traffic (attached), target p95 SLA, example prompts for accuracy checks, and any regulatory constraints on request retention.

Marissa — can you propose a concrete meeting cadence and the quant-profile artifacts we should review?

Thanks — Priya

Thanks Priya — adding some technical detail so everyone has the same expectations.

1) Batching:
- We'll measure effective batchability from the CSV you sent (Sana); expected median batching window 8–20ms for your traffic shape. We'll start with a conservative batch timeout of 10ms and target throughput improvements before widening.

2) Caching:
- We'll enable prefix/KV cache for repeated conversational prefixes. Please flag any prompts that must not be cached (PII/legal). Cache TTL initial value: 600s; we'll iterate based on hit rate.

3) Quantization profiles:
- Two candidate profiles: q4-lite (minimal accuracy loss, highest cost reduction) and q6-balanced (better accuracy, moderate cost). We'll run automated regression evaluations on your 200 test prompts and compute top-1/ROUGE deltas.

4) Routing & fallbacks:
- Canary policy: 50% traffic -> primary model variant with caching + batching; 50% -> primary without caching to compare latency and token usage. If p95 > 650ms in canary, traffic will failover to 'high-capacity' variant (same model, higher memory/replicas).

Deliverables before kickoff meeting:
- sample requests file (please confirm we can use the attached sample)
- initial quant-profile comparison PDF (we'll share)
- HubSpot mutual action plan link (Marissa will add timeline)

Sana — please confirm the retention constraints and any prompts that should not be cached. Also, which SLA target do you want us to show in the Console for the trial: p95=650ms or p95=500ms?

Attachment referenced: nimbledocs-sample-requests.json (JSON, 18KB)

- I'll own the HubSpot MAP updates and the initial canary run; Priya/Monica will own regression checks.
